title: Implement 6-Slot 4 GB Container Scheduler
instructions: Append after the previous chunk without editing earlier lines. Satisfy SRS-412-02-FR-007: The container scheduler shall enforce a concurrency limit of at most 6 parallel 4 GB sandboxes inside the 32 GB VM. Use a threading.BoundedSemaphore(6) so at most 6 sandboxes with memory_mb=4096 run at once (24 GB of the 32 GB VM); a seventh request blocks until a slot frees, and the slot is released in a finally block.
